olivia-pr: Quick sync 1 PR needs final OK on press kit, embargo timing, and analyst FAQ. Who can confirm before EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana-marketing: Drafting kit now. Proposal: US lift 11:00 PT, EU lift 20:00 UTC so EU reporters have morning. APAC will take Fri slots.

simon-product: Fine with split. Please include 3-line benchmark method bullets in FAQ (dataset, seq len, quant settings).

kevin-ops: Legal: we need a redaction clause for customer names. Otherwise green.

press-bot: Reminder scheduled -> embargo windows: 11:00 PT / 20:00 UTC. Confirm by 17:00 PT.

evan-press: Short quote draft: "Redwood makes production LLM serving predictable and cost-efficient for engineering teams." Thoughts?

jules-sales: Added demo link to kit: https://cal.com/redwood-demo?utm=press. Routing: tag=press -> inbound-sales.

maria-analyst-relations: I can brief Fri APAC and Fri EU afternoon. Need FAQ (10 Qs) + benchmark appendix by tomorrow 11:00 to prepare.

olivia-pr: Action list: ana update kit + embargo bot; kevin confirm redaction text in kit; evan paste one-line into kit; jules confirm tracking; maria expect FAQ by 11:00. I'll send reporter note at 17:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
